title: SEBI & CBDT Regulations for Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS)
publisher: SEBI & Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)

sections.content: Equity Linked Savings Schemes (ELSS) are notified under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act, 1961. ELSS investments carry a strict statutory lock-in period of 3 years (36 months) from the exact date of unit allotment. Premature withdrawals, pledges, or switching to other mutual fund schemes are prohibited during this 3-year period.

In an ELSS Systematic Investment Plan (SIP), each monthly installment is treated as a separate investment and is locked for 3 years from its respective deduction date. Under the Old Tax Regime, investments up to ₹1,50,000 qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C. All 5 supported HDFC schemes in this assistant are non-ELSS open-ended funds.
